text:
Silver Price in 1973
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1973, the LBMA silver price rose 61.9% between 1973-01-31 ($2.01) and 1973-12-31 ($3.26). The highest sampled price was $3.26 in December and the lowest was $2.01 in January. The mean of these observations was $2.59. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
